name: Media Card
author: Lucas Picotti
description: Media controls for the Omarchy bar with a player card: cover, progress, transport controls and every other player that is open.

barWidget.description: Now playing in the bar, with a card for every open player.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: How the widget looks in the bar. Cover with progress line takes the least room.

schema.label: Show player volume
schema.description: Adds a volume slider for the player to the card.

schema.label: Show "Also playing"
schema.description: Lists the other open players at the bottom of the card. The player tabs stay either way.

schema.label: Hide when nothing plays
schema.description: Removes the widget from the bar while no player has a track.
